title: A walk that fails is never parked on a task waiting for an answer
goal: The check between tasks found path-outline-align-walk failing and wrote it onto the task that owns the walk, but that task is waiting on one of the user's cards, so nobody will look at the failure until the card is answered. Fix the walk, and make sure a failing walk whose owner is blocked lands where a runner will pick it up.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-15 20:30 by the manager pass: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/path-outline-align-walk.json --no-build exits 1 with 'step 66 (panelMenu): 2 menus answer to "Align", so it does not say which one: Align on Mixed 124.0pt wide at x 1102.0 says "Inside keeps the outline within the shape. Outside grows it past the edge.", Align on Add Motion 25.0pt wide at x 1201.0 says "Animate a property of this layer..."'. The Add Motion plus is Sources/Photonz/MotionListInspector.swift ~717-720. Routing: queue/bin/sweep-slice-record.mjs ~98-125 writes onto every owner from ownersOfWalks without looking at the owner's status; the owner here is a-drawn-path-s-outline-settings-read-like-the-ic (blocked on a card since 2026-10-08), log line 2026-10-16T03:16:30Z. Check queue/bin/sweep-report.mjs does the same and fix both alike. Commit queue infra edits immediately (the loop stashes uncommitted ones).
acceptance: path-outline-align-walk passes at Next defaults, run on its own twice in a row, with the walk or the app changed according to which one was wrong (the log says which)
If two menus really answer to Align on the panel (the outline's Align and the Motion header's plus), the misnamed one is fixed so a person using VoiceOver hears the right name
The rotating check and the full sweep write a failing walk whose owning task is blocked onto the standing walk task as well, saying who owns it and that the owner is waiting on a card
A drill or test in queue/bin shows the routing: a blocked owner plus a failing walk ends up on a task a runner can claim

log.note: The WALK HARNESS was wrong, not the app. Reproduced step 66 failure. The Add Motion plus answered to 'Align' only through the harness's register of playtestControl markers (PlaytestPanelPress.registeredNames): the Align dropdown's marker, scrolled 104pt below the Appearance list's visible bottom, still has a frame lying under the Motion header, and registeredNames matched by frame alone. The plus's accessibility label is 'Add Motion', so VoiceOver already hears the right name (acceptance 2: nothing misnamed in the app). Fix: registeredNames skips a control marker whose nearest scroller does not hold the view, the rule fieldViews already keeps for rows. path-outline-align-walk ok twice in a row; 25 path walks and 12 register-heavy walks ok; Scripts/test.sh green (13301 tests).

Routing (commit 5beb7f4a): ownersOfWalks (sweep-notes.mjs) marks a walk whose every owner is blocked as waiting. sweep-slice-record.mjs still writes it on the owner and ALSO on the standing walk task (opening it if none is open), as '<walk> (owned by <id>, which is waiting on a card)'. The sweep block (machineBlock, used by sweep-report.mjs) lists it under 'Owned by a task that is waiting on a card, so this task takes them' and counts it in 'This task owns'. A walk with one blocked and one free owner stays with the free one. Drill: node queue/bin/slice-owner-drill.mjs sections 8-9 (all good); sweep-notes, interrupt, blind, line, parse and schedule drills all pass. CLAUDE.md and the sweep.sh schedule text say the new rule. Adversarial note: 'blocked' is the only status treated as waiting; a pending task with unmet deps is still counted as an owner a runner can reach.

path-outline-align-walk passes at Next defaults, twice in a row: the walk HARNESS was wrong (a control marker scrolled out of the Appearance list named the Motion header's plus 'Align'), fixed in PlaytestPanelPress.registeredNames, c0aacee5; the app's plus was already 'Add Motion' to VoiceOver. A failing walk whose owners are all blocked on a card now also lands on the standing walk task from both the rotating check and the full sweep, naming the owner, 5beb7f4a; slice-owner-drill sections 8-9 prove it. Verified: 25 path walks + 12 register-heavy walks ok, Scripts/test.sh green (13301), all sweep drills pass.
